body: Tested the one remaining untested edge case in the ported telecrystal UX: leaving the ring before the 600ms commit mark. Simulated under Xvfb: walked into the ring (auto-cast starts, confirmed gatecast_type=ACTIVE mid-cast at frame 15), then walked back out before commit. Confirmed the cast correctly cancelled (gatecast_type reset to NONE) and never committed to travel (dfzone_active stayed 0) -- matches town_gate_tick's own cancel-on-leave-before-commit logic exactly. No source changes -- pure verification. This closes out testing coverage for the full telecrystal cast state machine: start, commit, complete, and now cancel, all confirmed working.
title: Verified telecrystal cast-cancel path, no bugs found
